links.comparator_used: Pre-implementation: patients monitored with the Hypotension Prediction Index monitor and managed per usual, without the GDHT decision algorithm
links.outcome: Intraoperative hypotension (MAP <65 mmHg), cardiac index >2, and stroke volume variation <12 during pancreatectomy
links.quote: There was a 33.3% reduction in IOH (5.2% ± 0.1% versus 7.8% ± 0.3%, P < 0.01, a 31.6% increase in cardiac index >2.0 (83.7% + 0.2% versus 63.6% + 0.5%, P < 0.01), and a 37.6% increase in stroke volume variation <12 (73.2% + 0.3% versus 53.2% + 0.5%, P < 0.01).

design_hint: clinical decision-making algorithm paired with staff education
